E0165

Compound assignment needs a mutable place.

What

Compound assignment needs a mutable place.

Why

S17 permits updates only on a mutable name or an `&` parameter; a computed value has no place to update.

Fix

Bind the value with `:=`, then write `name {op} value`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0165: tests/ui/compound_non_place_target.stderr.

Error [E0165]: compound assignment needs a mutable place.
  --> tests/ui/compound_non_place_target.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     make() += 1
    |     ^^^^
 Why: S17 permits updates only on a mutable name or an `&` parameter; a computed value has no place to update.
 Fix: bind the value with `:=`, then write `name += value`
